correctness.rationale: For the two-dimensional Burgers pre-Lie product e₁e₁=2e₁,e₁e₂=e₂,e₂e₁=0,e₂e₂=e₁, independent symbolic expansion of the four ordered basis-pair Nijenhuis torsions yields C(B+C)=0, C(A−D)=0, (A−D)²+B(B+C)=0. Solving by C≠0 or C=0 gives rotation plane R and Q: C=0,(A−D)²+B²=0. Split -1 produces 3 planes sharing scalar line; nonsplit K-rational Q contributes only scalar matrices, hence R(K). For q odd split: N=3q²−2q, rank (1,6(q−1),(q−1)(3q−5)); nonsplit: N=q², ranks (1,0,q²−1). Aut two elements; Burnside with q scalar fixed points yields orbit counts q(3q−1)/2 or q(q+1)/2. Extension-field parity yields zeta (1−qT)²/(1−q²T)³ split or (1−q²T²)/((1−q²T)(1−q⁴T²)) nonsplit. Independently checked torsion exactly in SymPy; reviewed finite-field exhaustive source checker, not used for infinite proof.
